projects.title: Routed notes: URL identity
projects.completeScope: Classify exact notes URLs: /notes/new is create, /notes/<id> is read, /notes/<id>/edit is edit. IDs contain ASCII letters, digits, _ or -. Every other path is unknown. Do not confuse the URL owner with a form draft. This is a parser model, not React Router or native history.

projects.title: CRUD workspace: authoritative publication
projects.completeScope: Publish a supplied successful refresh only when its request ID matches the current owner; otherwise preserve current items. Authoritative returned items replace the whole list. This is a JavaScript state model, not actual API delivery, loading/error UI or abort.

projects.title: Deep link: delivery classification
projects.completeScope: Give API paths priority, serve an existing static file, refuse a missing /assets path, and admit a SPA navigation only for GET/HEAD with text/html in the declared Accept token list. This pure decision is not an Express response or actual Content-Type result.
